narrative_vs_numbers.summary: TCS consistently over-delivered on its AI revenue acceleration narrative, expanding annualized AI revenue from $1.8 billion in Q3 FY26 to $3.1 billion in Q2 FY27. However, management missed its margin expansion targets, as operating margins dropped to 24% in Q1 FY27 and remained flat at 24% in Q2 FY27 against a stated target to inch toward 25% plus.
